method.clock: AVC uses exact 1/30 spacing. VP9 WebM uses 1 ms ticks with each relative PTS equal to its nearest 30 fps lattice tick. No tolerance for dropped, duplicated or interpolated timestamps.
method.experiment: Render both carriers independently from the same verified original RGB inputs; tandem is a second encode in the same carrier. Preserve exact frame-index truth and compare current Full on identical delivered bytes.
method.method: Reuse the three windows starting at native pictures 0, 60 and 120. Same appearance and surrounding-motion rule, fixed point .10. No development fit.
method.sources: Two development and six held known source/donor components. Exclude every original, donor and component in the previous eight-second study. Retained publisher files have earlier project exposure.
